title: Add server-side suppression of incoming typing indicators
description:
Add receiveTypingIndicators (Boolean, default true) to the Chat object. When false, the server silently drops typing push events for that chat before delivery to the owner. Sender-unaware. Design: Option A (per-chat Chat field), not Option B (subscription filter — WebSocket-only gap) or Option C (account-level — too coarse, wrong semantic home on PresenceStatus).

MUST invariants to enforce:
MUST-1: Server MUST NOT deliver typing push event (SSE or WS) to a participant whose Chat.receiveTypingIndicators is false.
MUST-2: Server MUST return standard success response to Chat/typing regardless of suppression — sender MUST NOT be able to detect suppression.
MUST-3: In federation, suppression is applied by the home server at fan-out time; calling server invokes Peer/typing as normal.
MUST-4: receiveTypingIndicators settable only by Chat owner; server MUST return forbidden for non-owner.
MUST-5: Default value MUST be true; servers treat absent field as true for backward compatibility.

Files to change (7 locations across 3 files):
1. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md: Chat object fields (add field), Chat/set update list (add to patch keys), Chat/typing Server Behavior (add suppression check), Security Considerations (add note near Blocked Contacts)
2. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md: ChatTypingEvent section (add suppression check paragraph), Ephemeral Event Authorization (add bullet)
3. jmap-chat-wss-guide.md: Fan-out architecture section (add suppression check paragraph)
close_reason: receiveTypingIndicators implemented across main spec, WSS spec, federation spec, and guide. All review findings addressed.
